shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

assets.item: The sun / I see the sun.
assets.prompt: THE SUN. The bright round yellow-white sun shines high in a clear deep-blue sky and fills the upper middle of the photo, with soft rays around it; a thin strip of green treetops along the bottom edge gives scale. No clouds, no birds, no planes. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

RAIN. Heavy rain falls in clearly visible streaks onto a gray city street; drops splash in the puddles on the pavement and water runs along the curb, under a dark gray sky. The falling rain itself is the subject and is sharp. No people, no umbrellas, no cars. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

SNOW. Large white snowflakes fall thickly and clearly visible in the air over a quiet street where deep, clean white snow covers the ground, a fence and the roofs. The snow is the subject. No people, no cars, no snowman. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
